params.prompt: Edit this YouTube thumbnail. Keep EVERYTHING else exactly the same: the same man on the right (identical face and identity, long dark curly hair, green eyes, same grey knit sweater and dark collared shirt, same size and position in frame), the same blue gradient background on the left, the same blue-lit wall and wooden door on the right, same lighting and photoreal grade. CHANGE 1: remove all three yellow banner boxes and all their text completely, leaving the plain smooth blue gradient on the left side, no text anywhere in the image. CHANGE 2: change ONLY his facial expression to a stern warning look: brows drawn gently together and level, focused eyes locked on the camera, lips closed and firm, as if delivering bad news. Neither eyebrow is raised, not skeptical, not angry, no smile. Keep his hand on his chin exactly as it is.
